title: coleus calycinus
intro: Coleus calycinus, commonly known as Coleus aromaticus or Coleus fragrans, is a plant species belonging to the Lamiaceae family, known for its aromatic leaves and stems. The health benefits of Coleus calycinus include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which can help alleviate digestive issues, reduce fever, and protect against infections. The therapeutic actions of Coleus calycinus include its use in traditional medicine to treat respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and coughs, as well as its application in aromatherapy to reduce stress and promote relaxation. The bioactive constituents of Coleus calycinus include volatile oils, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
